episodes.synopsis: Prince Oscar, heir to the throne of Farsas, was cursed in his childhood - a curse that prevents him from producing an heir. He travels to Tuldarr, a nation of mages, to seek help from their king.
episodes.title: From a Blank Page Anew

episodes.synopsis: A band of thieves kidnaps Tinasha while Oscar is away. Now, he must negotiate for her safe return, but they demand that Oscar relinquish a Farsas royal treasure: his trusty sword, Akashia.
episodes.title: Emerging from a Glass Cocoon

episodes.synopsis: Tinasha and Prince Legis of Tuldarr are met with assassination attempts. A mysterious woman visits Farsas Castle and offers to bear Oscar's child.
episodes.title: Unanswered Prayer

episodes.synopsis: Oscar agrees to let Princess Nephelli of Yarda take refuge from strife in her homeland. However, they find an assassin has followed her into Farsas.
episodes.title: Unseen Visage

episodes.synopsis: Tinasha takes the throne once more as Tuldarr's queen. Oscar makes up his mind after Tinasha shocks all present at the coronation ceremony.
episodes.title: Returning the Promise

episodes.synopsis: Tinasha visits a school in Tuldarr when disaster strikes. The nation of Cezar launches an invasion on Farsas.
episodes.title: Bloodless Scars

episodes.synopsis: Oscar receives an unexpected guest, whose voice he recognizes. The secret of the witch's curse comes to light.
episodes.title: Joyful Sorrow

episodes.synopsis: Tinasha helps Travis deal with a pesky demon. Oscar finds a baby in the palace that is supposedly his child.
episodes.title: Half of Eternity

episodes.synopsis: Tinasha travels to Magdalsia to diagnose a magical malady, but comes across an enigmatic intruder instead.
episodes.title: Pride of the Past

episodes.synopsis: Valt, the newly-appointed chief mage of Farsas, investigates a series of mysterious deaths and suicides.
episodes.title: Once upon a Time with You

episodes.synopsis: Magdalsia's aggression forces Tuldarr into war, but Oscar learns the shocking truth behind the instigator.
episodes.title: At Memory's End

episodes.synopsis: With Tuldarr in grave danger, Tinasha must decide whether to do as Valt demands and destroy Eleterria.
episodes.title: Death of the Nameless Nation
